name: mtaa-fix
description: Root development launcher for the MTAA Fix applications

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix citizen-frontend install && npm --prefix admin-dashboard install && npm --prefix government-frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "backend,citizen-frontend,admin-dashboard,government-frontend" --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix citizen-frontend run dev -- --port 3000" "npm --prefix admin-dashboard run dev -- --port 3001" "npm --prefix government-frontend run dev -- --port 3002"
scripts.demo: concurrently --kill-others --names "backend,citizen,admin,government" --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run demo" "npm --prefix citizen-frontend run dev -- --port 3000" "npm --prefix admin-dashboard run dev -- --port 3001" "npm --prefix government-frontend run dev -- --port 3002"
